evidence.quote: We ratified the async job contract

observations.why: Ratifying a contract invokes agreed-process authority (legitimate) while the act of ratifying also establishes the facts of the contract (informational).

evidence.quote:
No blocking
call, and no lost work

observations.why: Negative framing of design constraints asserts control over the factual terms of the contract without invoking rank.

evidence.quote:
Key decision: remember dispatches, then the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call.

observations.why: Labeling a design choice as a 'Key decision' claims process authority while laying out the mechanism as a reasoned argument.
